capture.coverage: Current Kimi Code 2.2 native wire 1.5 canonical message events, native tool IDs/results and separate subagent wires. Streaming/context duplicates are markers rather than duplicate human turns. Millisecond timestamps, state v2 title/cwd and root/session/agent identity preserved.

Bounded raw wire markers retain controls, observed usage, reasoning and media references. No derived costs, inferred token totals, pricing, file edits, parent relationships or native resume. Legacy Python context/wire/checkpoints are unsupported; KIMI_SHARE_DIR is a legacy migration setting, current root override is KIMI_CODE_HOME.
